title: The Game That Took 22 Years to Make 🎮 #shorts
description:
Guess how many years the slowest video game ever took to make. Comment your number!

GTA 6 fans waited a long time, but the Guinness record is way longer: Kien, announced in 2002, released in June 2024.

Sources: Guinness World Records, Vandal (Sep 2026)
